DIRECTION RULES
D01 [other, all scenes] Visual Style: Realistic Sri Lankan cinematic drama, natural lighting, authentic environments and emotionally grounded performances.
D02 [editing, all scenes] Scene Structure: Fewer, longer scenes with multiple camera shots and continuous dramatic action.
D03 [editing, scene 1] A romantic montage follows: Anudi visits Kasun after work. Kasun prepares her favourite tea. They spend time talking and laughing. Anudi helps him arrange food containers. Kasun walks with her to her car. They exchange smiles before saying goodbye.
D04 [editing, scene 1] A sequence of connected moments shows his struggle. He visits a bank and discusses a business loan. He sits with a potential investor and explains his business plan. He makes phone calls to friends asking for financial support. He reviews his business documents and calculations late at night. Each attempt ends in disappointment. The bank cannot offer the required support. The investor doesn't believe the small business can handle such a large order. His friends are unable to help.
D05 [sound, scene 3] Silence.
D06 [lighting, scene 5] The interior has warm lighting, wooden tables and Sri Lankan-inspired design.
D07 [lens, scene 5] The camera slowly pulls back, revealing the restaurant and its customers.
D08 [editing, scene 5] FINAL TEXT ON SCREEN: "සමහර ආදර කතාවලට සල්ලි ඕනේ නෑ. තමන්ගේ හීන විශ්වාස කරන කෙනෙක් හිටියම ඇති."
D09 [other, all scenes] Kasun maintains the same facial appearance, hairstyle and body type throughout.
D10 [other, all scenes] Anudi maintains the same facial appearance, hairstyle and body type throughout.
D11 [other, all scenes] Anudi's father maintains the same appearance throughout.
D12 [other, place L03] Kasun's three-wheeler remains the same vehicle.
D13 [other, place L03] His early food business remains small and humble.
D14 [other, all scenes] His clothing gradually becomes more polished as the business grows.
D15 [other, place L11] The final restaurant must visually feel like the successful evolution of his original business.
D16 [other, all scenes] Maintain authentic Colombo streets, vehicles, homes and environments.
D17 [action, all scenes] Keep performances natural and avoid exaggerated melodrama.

SCENES TO BREAK DOWN
=== E01-S01 (place card: pick from the cards) ===
13: SCENE 01 — KASUN'S EVERYDAY LIFE
14: Location: Colombo roadside – Food three-wheeler
15: Duration: 0.46 minutes
16: Early morning in Colombo.
17: The city is waking up. Buses, tuk-tuks, motorcycles and office workers fill the streets.
18: Kasun prepares his small three-wheeler food business. He arranges short eats, fills his tea
19: flask and cleans his small counter.
20: An office worker approaches and orders tea.
21: Kasun smiles and serves him.
22: After the customer leaves, Kasun looks at his small business. He notices the limited space
23: and old equipment but doesn't lose hope.
24: He looks toward the busy road and quietly speaks to himself.
25: Kasun: "දවසක මගේම රෙස්ටුරන්ට් එකක් පටන් ගන්නවා."
26: He smiles and continues working.

=== E01-S02 (place card: pick from the cards) ===
27: SCENE 02 — ANUDI ARRIVES
28: Location: Colombo road – Family car and roadside
29: Duration: 0.38 minutes
30: A comfortable family car moves through Colombo traffic.
31: Anudi sits in the back seat, looking at her smartphone.
32: The driver stops near an office building.
33: Anudi gets out, carrying her handbag and umbrella.
34: She thanks the driver and walks toward the building.
35: Rain begins to fall.
36: She opens her umbrella and continues walking along the roadside, passing Kasun's small
37: food three-wheeler.

=== E01-S03 (place card: pick from the cards) ===
38: SCENE 03 — THE UNEXPECTED ENCOUNTER
39: Location: Colombo roadside – Near Kasun's food three-wheeler
40: Duration: 0.29 minutes
41: Anudi walks past Kasun's three-wheeler while holding her umbrella.
42: She tries to put her smartphone into the side pocket of her handbag.
43: As she slips the phone into the bag, it accidentally slips from her hand and falls onto the
44: roadside.
45: Anudi doesn't notice and continues walking.
46: Kasun notices the phone lying on the ground.
47: He quickly picks it up and runs after her.
48: Kasun: "මිස්! මිස්! ඔයාගේ ෆෝන් එක!"
49: Anudi hears him and turns around.
50: Kasun approaches her, holding out the phone.

=== E01-S04 (place card: pick from the cards) ===
51: SCENE 04 — A CONVERSATION THAT CHANGES EVERYTHING
52: Location: Colombo roadside – Near Kasun's food three-wheeler
53: Duration: 0.75 minutes
54: Anudi takes her phone from Kasun.
55: Anudi: "අනේ, Thank you! මම දැක්කෙවත් නෑ."
56: Kasun: "වැස්ස නිසා වෙන්න ඇති."
57: Anudi smiles and looks at his small food business.
58: Anudi: "මේ ඔයාගේ බිස්නස් එකද?"
59: Kasun: "ඔව්. පොඩියට පටන් ගත්තේ."
60: Anudi: "තනියමද මේ හැමදේම කරන්නේ?"
61: Kasun: "ඔව්. රුපියල් පන්දහසකින් පටන් ගත්තේ. තව ඉස්සරහට යන්න තමයි
62: බලාපොරොත්තුව."
63: Anudi looks impressed.
64: Before she can continue the conversation, her phone suddenly rings.
65: She checks the screen. It's her father.
66: Anudi: "හෙලෝ තාත්තේ."
67: Father (over the phone): "අනුදි, ඔයා කොහෙද ඉන්නේ? ඉක්මනට ගෙදර එන්න. අපිට
68: ඔයාගේ කසාදෙ ගැන කතා කරන්න තියෙනවා."
69: Anudi's smile slowly disappears.
70: Anudi: "හරි තාත්තේ. මම එන්නම්."
71: She ends the call.
72: Kasun notices her changed expression.
73: Anudi looks at him again.
74: Anudi: "එහෙනම් මම යන්නම්. ආයෙත් හම්බවෙමු."
75: Kasun: "හරි. පරිස්සමින් යන්න."
76: Anudi walks toward her destination.
77: Kasun watches her leave. After a moment, he returns to his small business, but his
78: thoughts are somewhere else.
